questions.q: Tell me about a product or feature you tested. How did you plan your testing and what kinds of bugs did you find?
questions.looks_for: A real product, a planned approach (requirements reading, test cases, priorities), types of testing done, and examples of meaningful bugs found and their impact.

questions.q: Describe the most serious bug you found. How did you report it and what happened next?
questions.looks_for: Clear bug report with steps, expected versus actual result, environment and evidence. Follows up until it is fixed and retested. Shows ownership and good communication with developers.

questions.q: You have only one day to test a new release that normally needs a week. How do you decide what to test?
questions.looks_for: Risk-based testing: focuses on critical user flows, recently changed areas, payment or data features, and past problem areas. Communicates clearly what was not tested.

questions.q: How do you decide which tests are worth automating and which should stay manual?
questions.looks_for: Automates stable, repeated, high-value checks like regression and smoke tests; keeps exploratory, usability and fast-changing areas manual. Mentions maintenance cost of automation.

questions.q: A bug happens on some users' phones but you cannot reproduce it on yours. How would you approach this?
questions.looks_for: Collects device, OS, app version, network and steps from users or logs; tries matching devices or emulators; looks for patterns; works with developers on extra logging. Does not dismiss it.

questions.q: A developer marks your bug as 'not a bug' and the release is tomorrow. You believe users will be affected. What do you do?
questions.looks_for: Stays calm, rechecks the requirement, shows clear evidence and user impact, discusses with the developer, and if still unresolved raises it with the lead or product owner to decide.

questions.q: Why do you want to work as a QA / software tester, and what do you want to grow into? Please state clearly your notice period or joining date, and your expected salary in ₹ per month or per year?
questions.looks_for: Gives a genuine reason tied to the work, a sensible growth direction, a clear notice period or joining date, and a clear salary figure or range in ₹. Honest about buyout or negotiable notice if relevant.
